description: Turn off a recurring care schedule (stops its reminders). Identify it by scheduleId, or by scope — plant (its active planting), bed, or garden-wide (neither) — optionally narrowed by type (water/fertilize/custom). Use when the user says to stop a watering/feeding reminder.

garden.description: Garden name; defaults to the user's first garden.

name: delete_schedule
title: Delete a care schedule
